test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 27 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Babulal runs a juice corner outside a park and sells giloy juice(giloy + water) in the morning. Initially he had 19 litres juice, which had giloy and water in the ratio 2 : 9. He sold 21over2litres juice. Later, in order to dilute it, he added some water and the ratio of giloy and water became 1 : 5. How much water was added?
solution:
**Given**

Quantity of juice = 19 litres

Ratio of giloy and water = 2 ∶ 9

Quantity of juice sold = 21over2 litres

**Calculation**

Quantity of giloy which is sold from the juice = (2/11) × (5/2)

⇒5/11 litres

Quantity of water which is sold from the juice = (9/11) × (5/2)

⇒ 45/22 litres

New quantity of giloy in juice = (2/11) × 19 - (5/11)

let x litres of water added 

New Quantity of water in juice = (9/11) × 19 - (45/22) + x

According to question

[(2/11) × 19 - (5/11)]/[(9/11) × 19 - (45/22) + x] = 1/5

⇒ [(38/11) - (5/11)]/[(171/11) - (45/22) + x] = 1/5

⇒ [(33/11)]/[(342 - 45)/22 + (x)] = 1/5

⇒ [(33/11)]/[(297/22) + x] = 1/5

⇒ [(33/11)]/[(297 + 22x)/22] = 1/5

⇒ [(33/11)] × (22)/(297 + 22x) = 1/5

⇒ (3 × 22)/(297 + 22x) = 1/5

⇒ 66/(297 + 22x) = 1/5

⇒ 66 × 5 = 297 + 22x

⇒ 330 = 297 + 22x

⇒ 330 - 297 = 22x

⇒ 33/22 = x

⇒ 1.5 = x

**∴ 1.5 litres of water is added in juice to make ratio of giloy and water in 1 ∶ 5.**
